```artifact
Feature: Doorstop System Requirements

  [REQ003] Doorstop shall provide unique and permanent identifiers to linkable sections of text.
  Scenario Outline: Linkable sections should have unique and permanent identifiers
    Given a new document is created
    When a linkable section is added
    Then the section should have a unique and permanent identifier
    Examples:
      | Document Content |
      | Example content 1 |
      | Example content 2 |

  [REQ004] Doorstop shall support formatting within linkable text.
  Scenario Outline: Linkable sections should support formatting
    Given a new document is created
    When a linkable section with formatting is added
    Then the section should support the specified formatting
    Examples:
      | Formatting |
      | Bold       |
      | Italic     |

  [REQ001] Doorstop shall support the storage of external requirements assets.
  Scenario Outline: External requirements assets should be stored
    Given a new document is created
    When an external requirements asset is imported
    Then the asset should be stored in the document
    Examples:
      | Asset File |
      | asset1.txt |
      | asset2.txt |

  [REQ016] Doorstop shall be able to import content from other requirements management tools.
  Scenario Outline: Content should be importable from other tools
    Given a new document is created
    When content is imported from another tool
    Then the content should be correctly imported and displayed
    Examples:
      | Source Tool |
      | ToolA       |
      | ToolB       |

  [REQ017] Doorstop shall be able to export content to interact with common text/document tools.
  Scenario Outline: Content should be exportable to common tools
    Given a document exists with content
    When the document is exported to a common text/document tool
    Then the exported content should be compatible and editable
    Examples:
      | Target Tool |
      | ToolC       |
      | ToolD       |

  [REQ007] Doorstop shall provide a way to view requirements as a document.
  Scenario Outline: Requirements should be viewable as a document
    Given a document contains requirements
    When the document is viewed
    Then the requirements should be presented in a readable format
    Examples:
      | Document Type |
      | PDF           |
      | HTML          |

  [REQ008] Doorstop shall provide a way to view document items interactively.
  Scenario Outline: Document items should be viewable interactively
    Given a document with items
    When the items are viewed interactively
    Then the items should be accessible and navigable
    Examples:
      | Interaction Mode |
      | GUI             |
      | CLI             |

  [REQ009] Doorstop shall provide the capability to baseline versions of requirements.
  Scenario Outline: Versions of requirements should be baselineable
    Given a document with requirements
    When a version is baselined
    Then the baseline version should be saved and identifiable
    Examples:
      | Requirement ID |
      | R001            |
      | R002            |
```
